items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I brought some people by your sets: Fostina [Dixon], Geri Allen probably, and some other . . .

ctx.x: Piano. I wish I had some of – last time I played the Showcase I used her.
I’ve played with – I’ve had quite a few women in my bands over the years, and played with – and I brought some people by your sets: Fostina [Dixon], Geri Allen probably, and some other . . .
Oh, the baritone player? Yeah, she was great.
